abstract: Serum placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) levels in patients with gynecological tumors were measured by two kinds of enzyme-antigen immunoassay kits provided by Innogenetics (PLAP-I) and Sangtec Medical (PLAP-S), and the combination assays for PLAP with other tumor markers were studied. None of the healthy women studied were PLAP positive, and the positive rate in patients with benign ovarian tumors was less than 6%. The positive rate in patients with ovarian cancers was about 35%, which was higher than the rates for other cancers. It was significantly higher in patients with ovarian serous cystadenocarcinoma (60%). Remarkably high PLAP-I values were observed in patients with dysgerminoma. By the combination assay for PLAP with CA54/61 antigen in ovarian cancers, the diagnostic efficiency increased compared with that for PLAP and CA125. We conclude that PLAP is useful in the diagnosis of ovarian serous cystadenocarcinoma and dysgerminoma and that CA54/61 is the better partner for the combination assay.
abstract_ja: 婦人科腫瘍患者の血清胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ（PLAP）値を、Innogenetics社（PLAP-I）およびSangtec Medical社（PLAP-S）の2種類の酵素抗原免疫測定キットで測定し、PLAPと他の腫瘍マーカーとの併用測定について検討した。健常女性はいずれもPLAP陽性ではなく、良性卵巣腫瘍でのPLAP陽性率は6%未満であった。卵巣癌患者の陽性率は約35%で、他の癌種より高かった。卵巣漿液性腺癌患者では有意に高く（60%）、特にディスジャーミノーマ患者ではPLAP-I値が著しく高値であった。卵巣癌におけるPLAPとCA54/61抗原の併用測定では、PLAPとCA125の併用に比べ診断効率が向上した。以上より、PLAPは卵巣漿液性腺癌とディスジャーミノーマの診断に有用であり、CA54/61が併用測定のより良い相手であると結論する。
